import base64,hashlib,json,os,shutil,tempfile,urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
repo='OnTrack-Development/OnTrack-voice'
url='https://api.github.com/repos/'+repo+'/contents/saas/console/io/voice-lab/index.html?ref=release%2Fvoice-v1-20261106'
cfg=json.loads(Path('/home/appontrack/ontrack-voice-link/config.json').read_text())
request=urllib.request.Request(url,headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+cfg['token'],'Accept':'application/vnd.github+json','User-Agent':'OnTrack-Voice-Lab-Deploy'})
with urllib.request.urlopen(request,timeout=12) as res: item=json.loads(res.read(180000))
assert item['sha']=='010e05e9292b421d9c22bf6d96ace4af3e878c3d'
html=base64.b64decode(item['content'])
assert hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len(html)).encode()+b'\0'+html).hexdigest()==item['sha']
assert b'Voice Lab 2026.11.07.14' in html and b'id="settingsDrawer"' in html and b'@google/genai@2.25.0/+esm' in html
target=Path('/home/appontrack/public_html/io/voice-lab/index.html')
assert target.is_file() and not target.is_symlink()
backups=Path('/home/appontrack/backup/voice-lab');backups.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
backup=backups/'index-before-hotline-010e05e9.html'
if not backup.exists():shutil.copy2(target,backup)
fd,temp=tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='.hotline-',suffix='.html',dir=str(target.parent))
try:
 with os.fdopen(fd,'wb') as f:f.write(html);f.flush();os.fsync(f.fileno())
 os.chmod(temp,0o644)
 os.replace(temp,target)
finally:
 if os.path.exists(temp):os.unlink(temp)
assert target.read_bytes()==html
req=urllib.request.Request('https://app.ontrackegy.com/io/voice-lab/?hotline=010e05e9',headers={'Cache-Control':'no-cache','User-Agent':'OnTrack-Host-Deploy-Verify'})
with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=8) as res:
 live=res.read(140000)
 assert res.status==200 and b'Voice Lab 2026.11.07.14' in live
print(json.dumps({'result':'deployed_verified','file':'/io/voice-lab/index.html','version':'2026.11.07.14','blob':'010e05e9292b421d9c22bf6d96ace4af3e878c3d','bytes':len(html),'public_verified':True,'backup':str(backup)},separators=(',',':')))
